`class TransitionStep`<br/>
**Implements:** `Cloneable`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.transition` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TransitionStep.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/transition/TransitionStep.java)

One step of a transition, opening or closing, that animates a progress from 0 to 1 and draws the UI through its drawing.

## Description

The progress starts at the first frame the UI is drawn, so a UI opened during a heavy frame still plays its whole step.
When a UI closes during its opening, the closing step starts from the progress the opening had reached.

- [Transitions](/use/learn/style-and-motion/transitions/#write-a-transition-of-your-own)

## Method details

<a id="TransitionStep-method-copy"></a>

### copy

`<T extends TransitionStep> T copy()` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: …

Returns a copy of the step, of the same class, with its fields and a copy of its animator: value, speed and listeners.
A UI plays copies of the steps of its transition; the fields of a subclass are copied as they are, without a copy of the objects they hold.
